messages:
Ethan (NovaEdge): Hi all — onboarding warmup is failing in staging. We're seeing intermittent 401s that claim the token is invalid and periodic 429 spikes when our warmup fanout starts. Started after we put a lightweight proxy in front of our runners.
Priya (CSM): thanks Ethan. Can you paste the SDK version, token issuer, and a tiny log snippet? Looping in @Samir and @Olga.
Ethan (NovaEdge): using python-sdk 0.4.1, tokens minted by our auth-service with exp ~300s. Minimal log: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings 401 {"id":"req_abc123","error":"unauthorized","hint":"invalid_token"}
```
Ethan (NovaEdge): curl with the same token from a dev box returns 200. The failing requests originate from our proxy which accepts GH Actions webhooks and fans out to runners.
Samir (py-sdk): two different smells: token mangling (proxy altering header) vs retry storming on 429. Any retry config in the client?
Ethan (NovaEdge): default retry config. We're firing 60 concurrent warmup requests across runners. Some responses include `Retry-After: 0` then the SDK repeats immediately and we get a cascade of 429s.
Olga (SRE): I'll pull traces — can you paste the raw Authorization header value (sanitized) as seen on the runner env vs what arrives at the edge? Sometimes proxies url-encode or base64-encode header values.
Ethan (NovaEdge): runner env header (sanitized): `Authorization: Bearer eyJhbG...+abc/xyz==`
Ethan (NovaEdge): edge inbound shows: `authorization: Bearer eyJhbG...%2Babc%2Fxyz%3D%3D` (note the `+` and `/` turned into `%2B` and `%2F` and `=` into `%3D`).
Samir (py-sdk): aha — the proxy is URL-encoding the header value when proxying. Redwood expects the raw token; URL-encoding changes signature. That explains 401s. The 429s are secondary from retries when the SDK immediately replays on `Retry-After: 0`. Two fixes: stop encoding headers, and tune retry behavior.
Priya (CSM): nice catch. Olga, can you confirm traces show a mismatch?
Olga (SRE): confirmed — traces show token mismatch at edge for ~18% of warmup requests where proxy encoded header. On the 429 side, our logs show many clients using `max_attempts: 8` + `Retry-After: 0`, which amplifies the burst.
Ethan (NovaEdge): the proxy uses `encodeURIComponent()` on all outgoing header values to be safe. We'll remove that for Authorization and any Bearer token headers.
Samir (py-sdk): SDK mitigation: set `respect_retry_after=True`, reduce attempts during warmup and add jitter. Example snippet: 
```
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'], max_concurrency=8,
                 retry={"max_attempts":3, "backoff_factor":2, "min_timeout_ms":300, "respect_retry_after":True})
# add randomized splay before starting each worker
sleep(random.uniform(0, 0.25))
```
Samir (py-sdk): we will also backport a change to treat `Retry-After: 0` as a small default backoff (e.g., 250ms) in the next patch. Tracked as SDK-PY-188.
Olga (SRE): Ops note: creating temporary onboarding throttle ticket while you remediate. Also monitoring traces for header-encoding symptoms.
ThrottleBot: Ops request created: OPS-4722 "NovaEdge onboarding temporary throttle"  assignee: infra-ops.
Ethan (NovaEdge): patched the proxy to pass Authorization raw, added 0..300ms splay, and lowered warmup concurrency to 12 per runner. Re-ran 5 warmups: 401s dropped to 0, 429s from ~22% to ~2%.
Priya (CSM): great result. Action items: 1) Ethan: remove header encoding and keep splay (Ethan) 2) Ethan: keep lower concurrency and introduce per-worker token caching (Ethan) 3) Samir: backport SDK-PY-188 and docs note on `respect_retry_after` (Samir) 4) Olga: watch OPS-4722 for 48h (Olga).
Samir (py-sdk): i'll open PRs for the backport and a short onboarding checklist entry about proxy pass-through for Authorization and safe retry defaults. PR link will be posted.
Ethan (NovaEdge): thanks everyone. We'll keep OPS-4722 open until the warmups look stable in production. Closing thread unless anything new pops up. :white_check_mark:
